scope: Account provider-attempt usage statistics, sub2api-compatible pricing sync, account price overrides, SQLite persistence, and Management API
conclusion: Targeted usage, pricing, config, management, SDK, and server build gates pass. Auth-file management entries now embed credential-free usage_stats so the quota/account list can render cumulative requests, tokens, and cost. The full repository suite reports unrelated pre-existing Windows/cache timing failures in untouched packages.

findings.title: Statistics are single-instance SQLite only
findings.evidence: The implementation intentionally does not add shared Postgres/object-store aggregation or a management frontend, per scope boundary.
